name: click-door
prompt: Make a door 0.9 m wide, 2 m tall and 0.05 m thick, hinged at its left edge. When someone clicks it, it should swing open 90 degrees over one second, and clicking it again should close it.

name: automatic-door
prompt: Make a sliding door panel 1 m wide, 2 m tall and 0.05 m thick that slides 1 m sideways over 0.8 seconds when someone walks within 3 metres of it, and slides back when they walk away.

name: lever
prompt: Make a lever: a bar 0.1 m wide, 0.6 m long and 0.05 m thick, pivoting about one end. When clicked it should pull down 60 degrees over half a second and stay down.
